cohort: The study included 52 pregnant women with pregnancies less than 34 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study found that 96.2% of pregnant women had no adverse reactions to magnesium sulfate, and observed various infant outcomes including 3 perinatal deaths and 2 cases of developmental delay.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery distribution was reported, with 27% term cesarean, 35% preterm vaginal, 25% full term vaginal, and 13% preterm cesarean.
